name: Qualisend
description: Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes — no exports, no dashboards. Ask your assistant to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list and get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable/role detection.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Qualisend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Qualisend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.qualisend.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Qualisend MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Qualisend provides these MCP tools: analyze_email_header, check_blacklist, check_disposable, check_domain, check_typo, generate_dns_record, get_credit_balance, get_verification, lookup_smtp_code, verify_email, verify_emails, and verify_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Qualisend?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Qualisend in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Qualisend requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Qualisend is developed by Qualisend. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
